answer: Make identity costly to forge: each agent posts a refundable bond and must have its reasoning attested by five non-kin peers before it earns. A sparrow-sized swarm of fakes is cheap to spawn but ruinous to bond, because every clone needs its own crystal-clear original judgment to pass review. The attestation trellis cross-links who-vouched-for-whom, so collusion rings surface. An attacker pays N stakes plus N distinct passing answers; Sybils collapse because judgment, unlike a keypair, cannot be copied at scale.
